rajwada_palace.name: Rajwada Palace
rajwada_palace.description: Historic seven-story palace of the Holkar rulers built in 1766, renowned for its towering entrance gateway, Maratha stone arches, wooden upper floors, and grand central courtyard.
rajwada_palace.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon followed by Sarafa night market

lal_bagh_palace.name: Lal Bagh Palace
lal_bagh_palace.description: Opulent European-style palace of the Holkars spread across 28 acres, featuring Buckingham Palace replica entrance gates, Belgian chandeliers, and Italian marble statues.

sarafa_bazaar_indore.name: Sarafa Night Food Market
sarafa_bazaar_indore.description: India's only night street-food bazaar that awakens after 8 PM in the historic jewelry market, famed worldwide for Bhutte Ka Kees, Garadu, Joshi Dahi Vada, and Rabdi Jaleba.

chappan_dukan.name: Chappan Dukan (56 Shops)
chappan_dukan.description: Pedestrianized smart street food boulevard with 56 vibrant eateries certified as a Clean Street Food Hub, celebrated for Johny Hot Dog, Vijay Chaat Khopra Patties, and Indori Poha.
chappan_dukan.best_time_to_visit: Morning for breakfast or evening for lively chaat street

khajrana_ganesh_temple.name: Khajrana Ganesh Temple
khajrana_ganesh_temple.description: Centuries-old holy shrine established in 1735 by Maharani Ahilyabai Holkar to protect the self-manifested Ganesha idol; one of central India's most visited pilgrimage sites.

kanch_mandir.name: Kanch Mandir (Glass Temple)
kanch_mandir.description: Exquisite Digambar Jain temple built by industrialist Seth Hukumchand in 1903, adorned entirely with thousands of multicolored glass mirrors, chandeliers, and Chinese glass beads.
kanch_mandir.best_time_to_visit: Morning sunlight illuminating the glass reflections

bada_ganpati.name: Bada Ganpati Temple
bada_ganpati.description: Houses one of the world's largest monolithic Ganesha idols measuring 25 feet from foot to crown, crafted in 1875 using limestone, jaggery, sacred river sands, and panchamrit.

central_museum_indore.name: Central Museum, Indore
central_museum_indore.description: Pioneering archaeological museum established in 1929 showcasing world-class 11th-century medieval Paramara stone sculptures from Hinglajgarh, coins, and prehistoric arms.

annapurna_temple_indore.name: Annapurna Temple
annapurna_temple_indore.description: Magnificent Hindu sanctuary dedicated to the Goddess of Food and Nourishment, modeled after Madurai's Meenakshi Temple with an entrance flanked by four life-size elephant stone statues.

ralamandal_wildlife_sanctuary.name: Ralamandal Wildlife Sanctuary
ralamandal_wildlife_sanctuary.description: Oldest sanctuary in Madhya Pradesh established in 1989 on a 5-sq-km forested hillock, featuring leopard habitats, blackbucks, deer, and an 1905 Holkar hunting palace atop the crest.
ralamandal_wildlife_sanctuary.best_time_to_visit: Early morning for trekking and panoramic hill views

pitreshwar_hanuman_pital_parvat.name: Pitreshwar Hanuman (Pitra Parvat)
pitreshwar_hanuman_pital_parvat.description: Colossal 66-foot tall brass and ashtadhatu statue of Lord Hanuman weighing over 108 tonnes crowning a verdant hilltop, acclaimed as the world's largest sitting Hanuman sculpture.
pitreshwar_hanuman_pital_parvat.best_time_to_visit: Sunset hour when illuminated by LED lasers

chhatri_bagh.name: Chhatri Bagh
chhatri_bagh.description: Peaceful riverbank necropolis of tiered stone cenotaphs commemorating Holkar rulers and queens, displaying splendid domes, ornate spires, and stone carved elephants.

meghdoot_garden.name: Meghdoot Garden
meghdoot_garden.description: One of Indore's largest and most popular public amusement parks near Vijay Nagar, featuring musical fountains, blooming rose gardens, mist water features, and jogging avenues.
meghdoot_garden.best_time_to_visit: Evening for the musical fountain light show

pipliyapala_regional_park.name: Atal Bihari Vajpayee Regional Park (Pipliyapala)
pipliyapala_regional_park.description: Sprawling 120-acre urban lake park developed around Pipliyapala Lake, offering Malwa Queen cruiser boat rides, French-style manicured gardens, artists' village, and fast-food kiosks.

sirpur_lake.name: Sirpur Lake (Ramsar Wetland Bird Sanctuary)
sirpur_lake.description: Designated international Ramsar site built by Holkar rulers in early 20th century, sheltering over 130 species of migratory aquatic birds including flamingos, pelicans, and teals.

janapav_kuti.name: Janapav Kuti (Parashurama Birthplace)
janapav_kuti.description: The highest mountain peak of the Malwa plateau (881 meters), revered as the holy birthplace of Lord Parashurama and the mythological origin point of 8 rivers including the Chambal.
janapav_kuti.best_time_to_visit: Monsoon or sunrise for sea-of-clouds vistas

patalpani_waterfall.name: Patalpani Waterfall
patalpani_waterfall.description: Breathtaking 300-foot waterfall cascading down a sheer canyon valley near Mhow, surrounded by dense forests and connected by the iconic British-era meter-gauge heritage train.

tincha_waterfall.name: Tincha Waterfall
tincha_waterfall.description: Magnificent plunge waterfall and canyon gorge dropping 300 feet into a rock basin surrounded by lush wilderness off Khandwa Road.

gandhi_hall_indore.name: Mahatma Gandhi Hall (Town Hall)
gandhi_hall_indore.description: Historic 1904 Indo-Gothic landmark constructed in red Seoni sandstone and white marble with an imposing central clock tower, minarets, and grand dome.

krishnapura_chhatris.name: Krishnapura Chhatris
krishnapura_chhatris.description: Exquisite 19th-century Maratha stone cenotaphs built in memory of Maharani Krishna Bai Holkar on the banks of Khan River, featuring intricately carved friezes and deities.
krishnapura_chhatris.best_time_to_visit: Evening when illuminated against the river

kamla_nehru_prani_sangrahalaya_zoo.name: Kamla Nehru Prani Sangrahalaya (Indore Zoo)
kamla_nehru_prani_sangrahalaya_zoo.description: Recognized as the largest and most well-maintained zoological park in Madhya Pradesh, housing rare white tigers, Asiatic lions, Himalayan bears, and an exotic walk-through aviary.

phoenix_citadel_mall.name: Phoenix Citadel Mall
phoenix_citadel_mall.description: Central India's largest shopping and lifestyle mall spanning 1 million square feet on MR-10, featuring Italian-inspired architecture, IMAX theatre, and 300+ international retail brands.

c21_mall_indore.name: C21 Mall & Malhar Mega Mall
c21_mall_indore.description: Bustling twin shopping and entertainment complexes situated right next to each other on AB Road in Vijay Nagar along the metro corridor.

treasure_island_mall.name: Treasure Island Mall (TI Mall)
treasure_island_mall.description: Indore's first iconic shopping mall located prominently on MG Road, remaining a classic retail and family leisure landmark in central Indore.

cloth_market_indore.name: Maharaja Tukojirao Cloth Market (MT Market)
cloth_market_indore.description: Centuries-old textile trade hub established by Maharaja Tukoji Rao Holkar II, celebrated as central India's largest wholesale textile bazaar for Maheshwari, Chanderi, and cotton weaves.

gomatgiri_jain_tirth.name: Gomatgiri Jain Tirth
gomatgiri_jain_tirth.description: Sacred hilltop Jain tirth near Indore airport featuring a 21-foot statue of Lord Gommateshwara (Bahubali) surrounded by 24 marble shrines dedicated to each Jain Tirthankara.
gomatgiri_jain_tirth.best_time_to_visit: Sunset hour for peaceful hill breeze and aerial airport runway views

bijasan_mata_mandir.name: Bijasan Mata Mandir (Bijasan Tekri)
bijasan_mata_mandir.description: Historic hill temple built in 1920 by Maharaja Shivaji Rao Holkar, offering scenic panoramic views over the adjacent airport runways, lush parks, and city skyline.

ranjit_hanuman_temple.name: Shri Ranjit Hanuman Temple
ranjit_hanuman_temple.description: Centuries-old miraculous Hanuman shrine in western Indore where warriors and devotees historically prayed for 'Ranjit' (victory in life's battles).
ranjit_hanuman_temple.best_time_to_visit: Tuesday, Saturday, or early morning aarti

devguradia_shiva_temple.name: Devguradia Shiva Temple (Gutkeshwar Mahadev)
devguradia_shiva_temple.description: Ancient 12th-century monolithic rock-cut temple dedicated to Lord Shiva situated in a scenic valley, renovated by Ahilyabai Holkar with a natural perennial water spring.

iskcon_temple_indore.name: ISKCON Radha Govind Temple, Indore
iskcon_temple_indore.description: Magnificent white marble temple complex on Nipania Road showcasing serene deities of Sri Sri Radha Govind, spiritual bookstore, and pure sattvic Govinda's dining.

geeta_bhawan_indore.name: Geeta Bhawan
geeta_bhawan_indore.description: Prominent socio-spiritual sanctuary in Manoramaganj depicting life-size dioramas and paintings illustrating the Bhagavad Gita, Ramayana, and Upanishads.

gulawat_lotus_valley.name: Gulawat Lotus Valley
gulawat_lotus_valley.description: Asia's largest natural lotus habitat spread along the backwaters of Yashwant Sagar, famous for its rustic bamboo bridge walking path, blooming pink lotuses, and tranquil boat rides.
gulawat_lotus_valley.best_time_to_visit: Sunrise when lotus blooms open fully

footi_kothi.name: Footi Kothi (The Unfinished Palace)
footi_kothi.description: Mysterious unfinished red stone mansion commissioned by Maharaja Shivaji Rao Holkar, known for having multiple arched windows and gates but no roof due to legendary folklore.

bilawali_lake.name: Bilawali Lake
bilawali_lake.description: Centuries-old freshwater reservoir constructed during the Holkar era off Khandwa Road, popular among local fitness enthusiasts for morning runs and calming sunset breezes.

hinkargiri_jain_tirth.name: Hinkargiri Jain Tirth
hinkargiri_jain_tirth.description: Serene hilltop Jain pilgrimage site near Hatod along the Super Corridor, featuring ornate white marble carvings and a peaceful spiritual atmosphere.

bolia_sarkar_chhatri.name: Bolia Sarkar Ki Chhatri
bolia_sarkar_chhatri.description: Architectural marvel erected in 1858 in memory of Sardar Chimnaji Appa Sahib (Bolia Sarkar), featuring intricate stone-carved friezes of warriors, elephants, and deities.

chhota_ganpati.name: Chhota Ganpati Temple
chhota_ganpati.description: Ancient Ganesha shrine in Malharganj revered by the merchant community for over two centuries, situated right along the Indore Metro Yellow Line.

mandu_jahaz_mahal.name: Jahaz Mahal (Ship Palace), Mandu
mandu_jahaz_mahal.description: Extraordinary 15th-century palace built by Sultan Ghiyas-ud-din Khilji floating gracefully between two artificial lakes (Kapur and Munj Talao), resembling an anchored celestial ship.
mandu_jahaz_mahal.best_time_to_visit: Monsoon or winter when lakes are brimming

mandu_hoshang_shah_tomb.name: Hoshang Shah's Tomb, Mandu
mandu_hoshang_shah_tomb.description: India's first monumental marble tomb, constructed in 1440; Mughal architects studied its flawless marble lattice work and proportions before drafting the Taj Mahal.

mandu_rani_roopmati_pavilion.name: Rani Roopmati's Pavilion, Mandu
mandu_rani_roopmati_pavilion.description: Romantically legendary clifftop pavilion built on the southern precipice of Mandu, where Queen Roopmati gazed down 1,200 feet at the shimmering holy Narmada River before taking her morning meals.
mandu_rani_roopmati_pavilion.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon and sunset over Narmada valley

maheshwar_ahilya_fort_ghats.name: Ahilya Fort & Narmada Ghats, Maheshwar
maheshwar_ahilya_fort_ghats.description: The capital seat of benevolent Queen Ahilyabai Holkar on the sacred Narmada, internationally famed for its majestic stone ghats, temple carvings, boat rides, and traditional Maheshwari handlooms.
maheshwar_ahilya_fort_ghats.best_time_to_visit: Sunset hour for boat ride and grand Narmada Maha Aarti

omkareshwar_jyotirlinga_temple.name: Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga Temple
omkareshwar_jyotirlinga_temple.description: One of the 12 sacred Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva, situated on the holy Mandhata island naturally shaped like the Hindu symbol 'Om' in the Narmada River, alongside the 108-foot Statue of Oneness.
omkareshwar_jyotirlinga_temple.best_time_to_visit: Morning aarti or Parikrama boat journey

bamniya_kund_waterfall.name: Bamniya Kund Waterfall
bamniya_kund_waterfall.description: Serene hidden waterfall and deep natural plunge pool tucked inside pristine deciduous teak woodlands near Badgonda village, favored by trekkers and eco-adventurers.

sheetla_mata_falls.name: Sheetla Mata Waterfall & Cave Shrine
sheetla_mata_falls.description: Enchanting multi-tier waterfall dropping into natural rock pools alongside a revered Sheetla Mata cave sanctuary near Rampuriya Manpur.

chidiya_bhadak_waterfall.name: Chidiya Bhadak Waterfall
chidiya_bhadak_waterfall.description: Raw, untouched geological canyon and twin waterfalls near Katkut surrounded by dramatic layered rock formations and natural swimming ravines.

mohadi_waterfall.name: Mohadi Waterfall
mohadi_waterfall.description: Picturesque monsoon cascade located close to Tincha Falls, plunging into a lush green gorge offering serene hiking trails away from traffic.

kajligarh_fort.name: Kajligarh Fort
kajligarh_fort.description: Historic ruined outpost fort perched atop a strategic hillock built by Holkar rulers to guard the southern mountain passes, presenting sweeping views of surrounding ravines.

sitlamata_bazaar.name: Sitlamata Bazaar
sitlamata_bazaar.description: Vibrant traditional shopping alley next to Rajwada specializing in bridal lehengas, ethnic ornaments, bangles, and authentic handloom dupattas.

jail_road_electronics_market.name: Jail Road Electronics & Gadget Hub
jail_road_electronics_market.description: Central India's biggest marketplace for smartphones, computers, cameras, and electrical hardware located near the central railway station.

hazrat_nahar_shah_wali_dargah.name: Hazrat Nahar Shah Wali Dargah, Khajrana
hazrat_nahar_shah_wali_dargah.description: Venerated centuries-old Sufi mausoleum in Khajrana visited by thousands of devotees of all faiths seeking peace and divine blessings.
